semantics.HIT: prior cache entry is correctness-equivalent and should be reusable
semantics.MISS: prior cache entry must not be reused

rationale.PRICE_ONLY: Price does not alter canonical football projections, lineup scoring or route-return MC, but it can change affordability, scenario feasibility and downstream decision stability.
rationale.OWNED_AVAILABILITY: Manager-owned availability is private decision context; it must not invalidate public Stage2 universe projections but must invalidate owned lineup/route and downstream decisions.
rationale.TEAM_FINANCE: Bank/sell-value/FT state does not alter player projections or owned-XI scoring, but changes legal route space; MC is conservatively invalidated until route-local reuse is separately proven.
rationale.MINI_LEAGUE_ONLY: Canonical football/lineup/MC distributions remain reusable; scenario action and stability may change because league utility is downstream decision context.
rationale.RUNTIME_CLASS: Numerical cache reuse across a changed runtime class is forbidden unless a later explicitly governed equivalence contract proves otherwise.
rationale.SCENARIO_OVERRIDE: Generic owner what-if overrides are conservatively correctness-invalidating across decision compute until narrower typed overrides are proven safe.
rationale.CHALLENGER_ONLY: Challenger layers are context-only and must not invalidate the canonical decision brain before explicit governed integration.
